edits.location: §2 R9: v0.3.2 specification block replaced by a pointer
edits.old:
Target (v0.3.2 restatement, in the owner's $h$-chart): for the exact normalised return $\widehat F=h^{-1}F_Wh$ with $|\widehat F-J|\le C_7|z|^7$, prove $|\Lambda-q_0\Lambda_1(\Theta_0)|\le C_2q_0^2$ with explicit $C_2$, where $\Lambda_1$ is the leading lattice-memory coefficient of §6.13 (chart values).

Inputs (all chart-native, §6.14): $q$-law $q'=q-q^2+[\tfrac{245}{216}+2\Re(a_{05}e^{-6i\Theta})]q^3+O(q^4)$; $\Theta$-law $\Delta\Theta=-\tau q+[\tfrac{89\sqrt3}{324}+\Im(a_{05}e^{-6i\Theta})]q^2+O(q^3)$; one-orbit bounds $q-\tfrac32q^2\le q'\le q-\tfrac12q^2$, $q_m\le q_0/(1+\tfrac12q_0m)$, $\sum q_m^3\le2q_0^2$ (DYAD-THM-NF-REM); Euler–Maclaurin $q^2\sum F(qm)=\tfrac{q}{1-6i\tau}+\tfrac{q^2}{2}+O(q^3)$; $a_{05}^2$ self-interaction to be bounded.

Degree-$\ge7$ budget `[ALG]`: per block the phase error is $\le C_7q^3$, hence the degree-7 contribution to $\Lambda$ is $\le2C_7q_0^2$ ($200q_0^2$ on $|z|\le\tfrac1{20}$, $60q_0^2$ on $|z|\le\tfrac1{40}$). Against $|\Lambda_1|\le0.0076520$, the leading term dominates only for $q_0<3.8\times10^{-5}$ ($C_7=100$) or $1.28\times10^{-4}$ ($C_7=30$), before the D2a terms. R9's theorem will carry a $q_0$ threshold of this order unless $C_7$ is sharpened (Dyadic §6.14 `[HEUR]`: deferred until a downstream budget shows need — this is that budget). The one-return sign bound $|\chi_1(-z)-\chi_1(z)|\le2C_7|z|^6$ (RRF Registry) is of the same order and is not an input to the leading term.

The v0.3 "corrected backbone" ($47/54$, $c_\theta^{(6)}$, $H(x)$) is retired (Appendix B): its inputs are archival/raw-frame objects that Dyadic SG-19 forbids transferring into the chart.

**Former OPEN R11 text (v0.3.1), retained for the record:**

Finding (external audit, confirmed here): Dyadic §6.9 lists $c_{32},c_{05},c_\theta^{(6)}$ as *raw six-step* coefficients (linear eigenframe, nonzero quartic jet) while attaching a Lie-gauge qualifier; the post-$H_2$ six-step jet has zero quartic part and $c_{32}^{\rm NF}=-\tfrac{97}{432}+i\tfrac{197\sqrt3}{324}$, $c_{05}^{\rm NF}=-\tfrac{49}{8640}-i\tfrac{307\sqrt3}{25920}$; the latter equals $6\bar\lambda\nu_5^{(1,6)}$ from Dyadic §6.11 exactly. Consequently $47/54$ and $c_\theta^{(6)}$ are raw-$Q$-variable quantities and $|\mu|^2+2\Re c_{32}^{\rm NF}=245/216\ne47/54$.

Active sub-items:
- Dyadic to state which frame its quintic ledger and asymptotic backbone refer to, and to record both frames with the $H_2$ relation :: `[OPEN]` (request in memo §1)
- Re-derive the R9 backbone ($a$, $c_\theta$) in the post-$H_2$ frame, or transform $\Lambda$'s derivation to the raw-$Q$ variable consistently :: `[OPEN]`
- CELL-C readability fractions restated in the post-$H_2$ frame (only $\mathcal I_{\rm lat}$ and the transfer coefficient are restated in v0.3.1) :: `[OPEN]`
- **Comparator transport across $H_2$.** With raw $w=H_2(z)=z+h_2(z,\bar z)$: $C_\to^{\rm raw}(a,b)=\bar z_az_b+\overline{h_2(z_a)}z_b+\bar z_ah_2(z_b)+O(|z|^4)$, $Q_{\rm raw}=|z|^2+2\Re(\bar zh_2)+O(|z|^4)$. This cubic correction is why raw backbone data cannot be attached to post-$H_2$ quintic coefficients. The identical-comparator counterexample is certified for identical post-$H_2$ $(Q,\Delta\Theta)$ (rev. 3) and for identical **canonical raw** comparator data transported through $H_2^{-1}$ (rev. 4: $+3.45\times10^{-4}$ vs $-3.35\times10^{-4}$ at $\alpha=0,0.5$) :: `[ALG consequence]` ✓ / `[OPEN]` for the final frame
- Required deliverable: one explicit coordinate ledger $W_{\rm raw}\xleftrightarrow{H_2}W_{H_2}\xleftrightarrow{\text{residual gauge}}W_{\rm final}$ recording, per frame, the six-step jet through degree 5, $Q$, $\Theta$, $C_\to$, backbone coefficients, $c_\theta$, $c_{32}$, $c_{05}$; R9 and R10 resume only afterwards :: `[OPEN]`
